Package com.bilt.pos.nexo.client

Class BiltNexoTerminalClient

java.lang.Object
com.bilt.pos.nexo.client.BiltNexoTerminalClient
public final class BiltNexoTerminalClient extends Object
Client for communicating with a Bilt payment terminal over the local Nexo Sale to POI protocol (v3.0).

The terminal exposes a single HTTPS endpoint at https://<device_ip>:8443/nexo. Each call sends a NexoTerminalAPI containing a SaleToPOIRequest and receives a NexoTerminalAPI containing a SaleToPOIResponse.

Unencrypted (development/testing)


 BiltNexoTerminalClient client = BiltNexoTerminalClient.builder()
     .endpoint("https://192.168.1.100:8443/nexo")
     .trustAllCertificates()
     .build();

 NexoTerminalAPI request = NexoTerminalAPI.builder()
     .saleToPOIRequest(myRequest)
     .build();
 NexoTerminalAPI response = client.request(request);
 if (response != null) {
     SaleToPOIResponse poiResponse = response.getSaleToPOIResponse();
 }

Encrypted (production)


 SecurityKey key = SecurityKey.builder()
     .passphrase("sharedSecret")
     .keyIdentifier("myTerminal")
     .keyVersion(0)
     .build();

 BiltNexoTerminalClient client = BiltNexoTerminalClient.builder()
     .endpoint("https://192.168.1.100:8443/nexo")
     .securityKey(key)
     .build();

 NexoTerminalAPI response = client.request(request);
 if (response != null) {
     SaleToPOIResponse poiResponse = response.getSaleToPOIResponse();
 }

Verified TLS (recommended)

Rather than disabling verification with BiltNexoTerminalClient.Builder.trustAllCertificates(), trust the merchant (or small-merchant-pool) CA certificate so any device leaf certificate issued under it is accepted, and verify the device identity against the certificate's synthetic hostname instead of the connection IP:


 BiltNexoTerminalClient client = BiltNexoTerminalClient.builder()
     .endpoint("https://192.168.1.100:8443/nexo")
     .trustCertificate(Path.of("/etc/bilt/merchant-ca.pem"))
     .expectedHostnamePattern("*.live.pos.bilt.com")
     .build();

  • Method Details

    • request

      public com.bilt.pos.nexo.model.NexoTerminalAPI request(com.bilt.pos.nexo.model.NexoTerminalAPI request) throws BiltNexoClientException
      Send a Sale to POI request to the terminal and return the response.

      If a SecurityKey was provided to the builder, the request is automatically encrypted and the response is decrypted.

      Parameters:
      request - the request envelope; must have saleToPOIRequest set
      Returns:
      the terminal's response envelope containing saleToPOIResponse, or null if the terminal returns an empty body (e.g. abort requests)
      Throws:
      BiltNexoClientException - if serialization, encryption, HTTP transport, decryption, or deserialization fails

    • request

      public com.bilt.pos.nexo.model.NexoTerminalAPI request(com.bilt.pos.nexo.model.NexoTerminalAPI request, Duration timeout) throws BiltNexoClientException
      Send a Sale to POI request with a per-request timeout override.
      Parameters:
      request - the request envelope; must have saleToPOIRequest set
      timeout - per-request timeout, or null to use the client default
      Returns:
      the terminal's response envelope containing saleToPOIResponse, or null if the terminal returns an empty body (e.g. abort requests)
      Throws:
      BiltNexoClientException - if any step in the request/response pipeline fails
